The total distance Sid traveled is  

\[
110\text{ mi}+140\text{ mi}=250\text{ mi}.
\]

The total time he spent traveling is  

\[
2\text{ h}+3\text{ h}=5\text{ h}.
\]

Average speed is defined as total distance divided by total time, so  

\[
\text{Average speed}= \frac{250\text{ mi}}{5\text{ h}} = 50\text{ mi/h}.
\]

All three solutions reach the same result, and the calculation follows directly from the definition of average speed.  

**Final answer: 50**
